title: malus × kaido
intro: Malus × kaido, commonly known as Japanese crabapple, is a hybrid plant derived from Malus baccata and Malus prunifolia. It has been traditionally used in East Asian medicine for its various health benefits, including its ability to lower cholesterol levels and improve cardiovascular health. The plant exhibits therapeutic actions such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents, including flavonoids, phenolic acids, and triterpenoids. These constituents are thought to contribute to its potential therapeutic applications in the management of oxidative stress and inflammation-related disorders.
